This is definitely one of my favorite games on steam. I used to play black ops zombies so the perks system is definitely something I love. I like the aesthetic of the graphics and the enemies are engaging. Its really fun to get in groups and play with your friends as well.

One of the best games I've ever played; its fun solo and with friends having immense replay value. Every map is beautiful and fun to explore. Bosses are big and imaginative, Items are unique and complex with plenty of room to theory craft a new 'build' each run. Every 'Survivor' is fun and intuitive with their own strength and weaknesses. There are plenty of characters (with many more on the way through updates) and items to unlock through achievements and finding secret stages and bosses.

Some items are bad and dont work the way you think they should. Some areas of maps require double jump to traverse, it can be hard to find the teleporter at times(Scorched Acres can be a bit frustrating), friends can steal items on accident and theres no way to trade or drop. Stages 30 and up have frame drop when too many monsters spawn and the sound turns off randomly.

There are plenty of ways the game can improve over the next few scheduled updates but even at the state the game is now its absolutely worth every penny.

From launch to +100 hours of game play, every second is enthralling and memorable.
